sources.changes: SKILL.md kept nearly verbatim with linked references, an explicit authority boundary for pushes, secrets, schedules, and PRs, and CodeLayer as one option among the runners; references copied verbatim. references/example-skill.md is wrapped in a fence under a short header so its paths and frontmatter read as an example of a separate skill. The owned entrypoint explicitly requires adapting runner/prompt examples to current task authority rather than inheriting push or permission-bypass commands.
